name: Yanzuma Koharu ~Omae no Yome wa Ore no Mono~
original_name: ヤンヅマ心春 ～お前の嫁は俺のモノ～
source:
You play the husband of a happily married couple.
Some day an old friend of your wife appears and suggest that she become a model for a sexy magazine...
